svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "Noto Sans", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Reviewer run: workflow, osf, child
svg.desc: The three containers involved in a reviewer run and what the change altered in each: the workflow now sets the retention environment and uploads the home, osf keeps and fills the home, and codex no longer discards its session.
